name: Bento
note: Modular tiles of work and numbers.
thesis: A dashboard-as-portfolio: an asymmetric-but-tidy bento grid of rounded, hairline-bordered tiles on a near-black canvas, where every tile is a different thing — a thumbnail, a big number, a chart, a quote, a live status, a map, a capacity heatmap — unified by one warm amber accent, mono labels, and oversized tabular numerals.

tokens.bg: #0a0b0f (with a faint top-left amber radial bloom)
tokens.fontDisplay: ui-sans-serif / system-ui, weight 600–650, letter-spacing -0.035em on display, -0.02 to -0.04em on numerals
tokens.fontMono: ui-monospace / Geist Mono — every label, metric, eyebrow, tag, table header, axis tick; uppercased, +0.08–0.12em tracking
tokens.border: 1px hairlines #232838 default, #2f3650 on hover/focus; tiles sit on a #121420 raised slate over the #0a0b0f page
tokens.motion: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 160–200ms; link-bearing tiles lift -2px + brighten border on hover; live status dot + map ping pulse (both gated by prefers-reduced-motion)

layout: A 12-column CSS grid with grid-auto-rows ~118px and a 16px gap, max-width 1240px. Tiles claim space with span helpers (3/4/5/6/7/12 cols) and an optional 2-row span, so a few large feature tiles (a 6-col×2-row intro, a 6-col×2-row work hero, a 6-col×2-row quote) anchor each band while smaller stat/status/chart/map tiles pack around them — asymmetric masses, consistent gutters. The page is a vertical stack of bento BANDS (hero+stats, work+chart+map+donut, capabilities+quote, full index+process, team+awards+capacity, budget+brief) each its own grid, separated only by the gap. A mono running head and a mono link-grid footer bracket it. Everything is a card; the page itself shows almost no bare background except the gaps.

sections.name: running-head
sections.what: Breadcrumbs + glowing amber rounded-square brand mark (FIELDWORK) + est. tag + mono nav.
sections.restyle: Breadcrumbs inherit the re-pointed dark fg tokens; the mark is an amber-gradient rounded square with a glow ring; Badge is reskinned to a mono uppercase hairline 'tag'.

sections.name: hero-band
sections.what: A big intro tile (eyebrow, two-tone display headline, lede, primary+ghost CTAs) beside a 2×2 of stat tiles: a circular-progress 'projects shipped' ring, a 'founded' numeral, a live availability toggle, and an 'awards' numeral.
sections.restyle: Intro tile gets a slate gradient + amber corner bloom; primary Button forced to an amber gradient with a glow, ghost Button a hairline that turns amber on hover; circular Progress track recolored to a hairline with amber bar and a mono numeral centered inside; Switch tinted amber driving a pulsing status dot.

sections.name: work-band
sections.what: A section heading tile, one large featured work thumbnail (6×2) plus three smaller thumbnails, a 12-month area-chart tile, a map tile, and a work-mix donut tile.
sections.restyle: Thumbnails are grid-lit dark canvases with an oversized two-tone monogram glyph (per-project accent tone) and a stretched <Link>; Chart.Area stripped of axes/grid, single amber series with a soft fill, mono tick text; Chart.Donut recolored to the accent + 3 secondary hues with a hand-rolled mono legend; the whole tile lifts on hover.

sections.name: capabilities-band
sections.what: A heading tile, a large pull-quote tile with author chip, and four capability tiles (number, title, body, mono tag row).
sections.restyle: Quote tile gets a slate gradient + serif quotation mark + one amber word; Avatar uses kit fallback initials; capability tiles are hairline cards that brighten their border on hover with amber mono numbers and Badge 'tags'.

sections.name: index-band
sections.what: A wide project-index tile (flush-grid rows: num / title / discipline / year↗) with a Pillbox filter + Pagination, beside a process/questions Tabs tile (Timeline + Accordion).
sections.restyle: Index rows are hairline-separated and title-goes-amber on hover with a stretched <Link> per row; Pillbox + Pagination get near-black fields, hairline borders, amber active state; Tabs underline variant becomes mono uppercase labels with an amber active tab; Timeline connectors use the hairline line with one amber step; Accordion flattened to hairline rows whose triggers turn amber on hover.

sections.name: studio-band
sections.what: A team tile (avatar + name + mono role rows), an awards tile (Table + clients Badge cloud), and a live studio-capacity heatmap tile (TimeGrid) with a ReasonTag readout.
sections.restyle: Table recolored to transparent dark rows, mono uppercase headers, hairline rules, row-hover band; TimeGrid cells become small near-black hairline squares that fill amber when 'booked', mono axis labels; ReasonTag underline theme as a quiet inline 'why this %' annotation; Separator a faint hairline.

sections.name: contact-band
sections.what: A budget-pad tile (MoodMeter + ReasonTag readout) beside a brief Card tile (Composer + Progress meter + send), with a received success state.
sections.restyle: MoodMeter color set to the one amber var, sized to the tile; Card flattened to a transparent, shadow-free shell whose header/body/footer keep hairline dividers; Composer field forced to a near-black rounded input with an amber focus ring; Progress as an amber character-count meter; Button primary = amber gradient.

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Brand mark + studio line, mono link grid, fictional-studio note + back-to-gallery link.
sections.restyle: Mono link grid turning amber on hover; an amber-bleed hairline rule; back link in the one accent.

palette.restyle: Two roles only: primary = amber gradient (#fbbf24→#f5a524) on dark ink text, 11px radius, soft amber glow shadow that grows on hover; ghost = transparent hairline that turns amber on hover. Disabled → 40% opacity, no glow.
Reskinned to a mono uppercase 'tag' — 7px radius, near-black fill, hairline border, +0.08em tracking; the accent variant tints text+border amber over a 14%-amber wash.

Flattened to a transparent, border-0, shadow-0 shell that fills its tile; header/body/footer keep 1px hairline dividers so the brief reads as a sectioned panel inside the bento card, not a nested card.

Circular variant: track recolored to a hairline ring, bar to amber, with a mono numeral absolutely centered for the 'projects shipped' stat. Bar variant: thin hairline track, amber fill, used as a brief character-count meter.
Tinted amber and wired to a live availability tile; its on/off drives a pulsing green 'open' status dot and the headline copy.
Axes/grid/dots removed; a single amber series (color via the --b-accent var) with a low-opacity fill; tick + tooltip text forced to mono subtle ink — a calm sparkline-like trend tile.
Recolored to amber + emerald/rose/sky secondary hues, legend hidden and replaced by a hand-rolled 2-col mono legend so it sits tidily in a 3-col tile.
Underline variant; tablist on a hairline base; tabs become mono uppercase subtle labels; active tab is amber (label + underline), no heavy pill.
Connectors/dots use the hairline line via the re-pointed border var; exactly one step (system & build) carries the amber accent to mark design-becomes-code.
Flattened to hairline-separated rows; medium-weight triggers in primary ink that turn amber on hover; no fills.
Transparent dark rows with hairline bottoms; header cells become mono uppercase subtle labels; rows hover-tint to the raised slate; the project column lifts to primary ink.
Cells become small near-black hairline rounded squares; the 'on' (booked) tone is amber; row/column labels forced to mono subtle ink — a literal studio-capacity heatmap tile.
Near-black raised field, hairline border, 10px radius; chips read as small dark mono tags; placeholder in subtle ink; sized to share a tile cap with a heading.
Buttons become near-black hairline squares; the current page tints amber over the amber wash.
color set to the single amber var so the budget pad's curve, handle, and posted ghost match the accent; sized to fit the tile with no extra chrome.
Underline theme so the agentic 'why this number' affordance reads as a quiet inline mono annotation (budget figure; capacity %) rather than a loud chip.
Editable field forced to a near-black rounded input inside the brief Card with border/rounding overridden and an amber focus ring; reads as part of the tile.
Kit fallback initials on the dark slate; no glow ring (reserved emphasis) so the quote author + team rows stay restrained.
All inherit the locally re-pointed semantic tokens (bg/surface/border/fg/accent) so they read near-black natively; Tooltip surface darkens to the raised slate.

contentArchetype: A fictional design + engineering studio (FIELDWORK) one-page portfolio rendered as a dashboard: hero thesis + studio stats, featured + indexed work, a 12-month shipped-work trend, a work-mix split, a location map, four capabilities, a pull-quote, a brief→build process, team + awards + clients, a live studio-capacity heatmap, and a budget-aware contact brief. Confident, terse copy; mono numerals and labels everywhere; numbers treated as first-class content.
remix: Swap the single --b-accent hue to re-theme instantly — it drives buttons, charts, the donut's lead slice, the TimeGrid 'booked' tone, the MoodMeter, the status dot wash, focus rings, and every hover. Because the whole palette is re-pointed onto the shared react-fancy semantic tokens under one scope class, the look is portable: lift the .insp-bento token block + the bn-* tile rules into any react-fancy project and the kit instantly wears Bento. The structural idea — a 12-col grid where span helpers + a row-span build a few large feature tiles around many small ones — is the reusable bones; fill the tiles with whatever metrics/components a given app has (it's a natural fit for any analytics or product dashboard, not just a portfolio). Blend with Dark Studio by keeping the near-black tokens and flush mono labels but flattening tiles back to full-bleed sections; blend with Swiss/Minimal by flipping the tokens light, widening the gaps, and trading the amber for a single restrained accent while keeping the modular grid.
